summaryParagraphs: This PR adds Documents Room frontend agent guidance. It introduces a dedicated skill, a testing playbook, and local AGENTS.md guidance under the Documents Room page area, plus an INVARIANTS.md file documenting important behavioral constraints.

The PR is designed to reduce accidental regressions in a complex frontend surface by giving agents explicit domain context, testing expectations, and invariants. It is fully documentation-based and touches only four files.
